seo.title: Online Timer - Tap to Tool
seo.description: Use the Online Timer from Tap to Tool to create multiple countdowns. Ideal for productivity, workouts, and cooking. Saves your settings automatically.
seo.keywords: online timer, timer online, countdown, time counter, multiple timers, study timer

schema.app_description: Create multiple online countdown timers with automatic saving and personalization.
schema.howto_name: How to Use the Online Timer
schema.howto_description: The Online Timer is a free and precise tool for time measurement.
schema.step1_text: Click on the Play/Pause icon (▶/⏸) to pause and resume the timer.
schema.step2_text: Click on the Lap button to allow (or not) your timer to ring 5 times in a row.

ui.intro_text: The Online Timer from Tap to Tool allows you to manage multiple countdowns simultaneously, making it ideal for precision and organization.

content.feature_1_text: Start several countdowns at once for different tasks.
content.feature_2_text: Name each timer to quickly identify its purpose.
content.feature_3_text: Drag the cards to prioritize the timers ending first.
content.feature_4_text: Configured timers are saved in your browser for continuous use.
content.usage_step_1: 1. Click '+ New Timer' to add a new counter to your list.
content.usage_step_2: 2. Set the desired time (hours, minutes, and seconds).
content.usage_step_3: 3. Click on the card title to rename it.
content.usage_step_4: 4. Start the countdown and drag cards to organize your view.
content.footer_share_text: Need multiple timers? Explore the Tap to Tool Timer!
